question: A 30-year-old woman, previously healthy, presents a picture of right facial weakness in the course of about 20 hours, so she can not close her right eye and her mouth has been twisted. Refers to see double with the right lateral gaze. Which of the following diagnostic possibilities seems most likely?

options.opd: Left sylvian infarction with involvement of the rolandic operculum.
options.ope: Protuberant involvement due to an outbreak of multiple sclerosis.
